title: 长沙臭豆腐为什么是黑的？一锅卤水发酵两年 | Why Changsha's Stinky Tofu Is Black 🖤
description:
越臭越香，你敢恰一块吗？评论区见。

别的臭豆腐是白的，长沙的却是黑的——秘密藏在一锅卤水里。香菇、冬笋、浏阳豆豉一起发酵，整整泡上两年，越发酵越黑越臭，臭味来自一种叫「3-甲基吲哚」的东西。可一下油锅，高温把臭味挥发掉，只剩下香：外皮墨黑焦脆，里面雪白味鲜。1958 年，毛主席在火宫殿尝过一句「闻起来臭，吃起来香」，如今火宫殿臭豆腐已是国家级非遗。长沙人见面就问你一句——恰了冇？

Most stinky tofu is white; Changsha's is black — and the secret is one pot of brine. Shiitake, winter bamboo shoot and Liuyang fermented black beans steep together for two whole years; the longer it ferments, the blacker and stronger it smells, thanks to a compound called skatole (3-methylindole). But the moment it hits hot oil, that stink volatilizes away, leaving only aroma: a charred-black crust and a snow-white, savory center. In 1958 Chairman Mao tried it at Huogongdian and said it "smells foul but tastes wonderful"; today Huogongdian's stinky tofu is a national intangible-heritage craft. In Changsha, the local greeting is simply: qia le mao? — "Eaten yet?"
